label: Evacuation alerts for Altadena during the Eaton Fire, January 7-8, 2025

sources.citygate: Citygate Associates for LA County Fire, Investigation Report of the Eaton Fire Evacuation Alerts, revised May 18, 2026 (Tables 1-7)
sources.pbs: PBS WARN alert archive rows in the FSRI timeline dataset (Genasys codes)
sources.press: Los Angeles Times, January 26, 2025; NBC News, January 23, 2025

alerts.note: The southwest section left out at 3:25 a.m. No warning came before it. Its exact boundary isn't public, so the replay reports every request against both west-side order times.

facts.what: First structure fire west of Lake Avenue reported by a LACoFD battalion chief (Glenrose Ave and W Loma Alta Dr)
Incident Command begins the west-of-Lake evacuation expansion after hearing radio traffic
AccessLA, the county's paratransit agency with over 1,800 vehicles, ready to help; it was never called
facts.source: LAist, Despite three 911 calls, two homebound disabled men died in the Eaton Fire waiting for rescue

facts.what: Fire front one block west of Lake Avenue between Concha Street and East Los Flores Drive (FireGuard)
